description: Explain an ISO 20022 payment message. pacs.008, pacs.009 and camt.053 get a plain-language narrative; pacs.002, pacs.004, camt.052 and camt.054 get a structured field projection. Case messages (camt.056 cancellation request, camt.029 resolution, camt.110 investigation request, camt.111 investigation response, the older camt.026, camt.027, camt.028 and camt.087, and the Swift Tracker messages trck.003 alert and trck.005 case status) get the projection plus a `case` field: case id, investigation type, status, reason, the underlying payment's UETR and references, camt.111 answer details (booking confirmation, payment status, amendments, compensation, value date adjustment) and any MT 199 copy Swift embedded in a delivered camt.110, with what it leaves out. All get an operator summary and quick insights. Field projection for triage, not usage-guideline rule validation.
